capabilities: Share a note as a public link from the right-click menu
Upload content to guest or free storage tiers
disambiguation: Not a full site publisher; Digital Garden and site features live in a separate plugin.
extras: Freemium: guests get 100 MB storage with 7-day content TTL, signed-in free users get 200 MB and permanent sites with ~180-day idle archive. The README mixes user docs with developer/build details, and notes the API's TTL behavior is still in transition ('until Phase 4'). Links to website, help, YouTube guide, and X/Twitter support.
problem: Publishing a note as a public link normally requires an account, Git, or site setup; this gives a one-click link for a single note.
summary: Plugin that shares a single note as a public URL via right-click, using a hosted service without an account or Git setup.
